description: Filters, sort and page become parameters, never SQL text

output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM (SELECT
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`heading` AS `heading`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`author_id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`author_id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`author_id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`author_id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`author_id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`author_id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `author_id`
FROM `post` AS `t`) AS `post_view` WHERE (`post_view`.`heading` LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND ((`post_view`.`owner` = ? OR `post_view`.`visibility` IN ('public', 'authenticated')))

SELECT * FROM (SELECT
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`heading` AS `heading`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`author_id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`author_id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`author_id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`author_id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`author_id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`author_id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `author_id`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`) FROM `author` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`id` = `t`.`author_id` LIMIT 1) AS `author`
FROM `post` AS `t`) AS `post_view` WHERE (`post_view`.`heading` LIKE ? ESCAPE '\') AND ((`post_view`.`owner` = ? OR `post_view`.`visibility` IN ('public', 'authenticated'))) ORDER BY `post_view`.`updated_at` DESC, `post_view`.`heading` ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
